headline: Oil prices continue to rise, Brent again above $100
summary: Oil prices rebounded and kept rising after reports that Chinese refineries are halting fuel exports. Brent crude once again exceeded $100 a barrel.
why: Brent is the main global crude oil benchmark, and changes in refined product supply from major producers and processors feed through to fuel prices worldwide.

impacts.name: Brent crude
impacts.why: Reports that Chinese refineries are halting fuel exports reduce product supply and push crude prices higher.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Reports that Chinese refineries are halting fuel exports tightened supply expectations, pushing Brent back above $100 a barrel after earlier morning declines.
